title.narrative: Implementing and monitoring San Nicolas de los Garza’s 2030 City Vision, through climate action and public space transformation

description.narrative:
The project arises as a second phase of the project “Consolidation of a City Vision for urban and territorial development of the municipality, aligned with the 2030 Agenda and the New Urban Agenda” (2019-2021), between UN-Habitat and the municipality of San Nicolás de los Garza, Nuevo León. This new phase aims to continue providing technical support to the city to achieve urban prosperity, while implementing global agendas for sustainable development. Particularly, it seeks to promote the materialization of some priority action strategies framed in San Nicolas de los Garza’s City Vision towards 2030, which was developed during the first collaboration with the municipality. This includes developing strategic urban interventions and consolidating the municipal planning framework and action, focusing on climate action, public space and monitoring tools to follow up on the implementation of the City Vision and the SDGs. These interventions will be based on the principles of sustainable urbanization and will employ municipal and metropolitan approaches.
The specific objectives of the collaboration include to: 1. Define a municipal strategy for climate action that considers a roadmap and specific proposals for action and mitigation projects and climate change adaptation from a local perspective. 2. Generate a strategy for the intervention and design of public spaces, based on participatory processes, enabling the construction, rehabilitation, and improvement of safe, inclusive, and accessible green spaces for all. 3. Develop tools and strengthen the capacities of the municipality to ensure the monitoring and impact assessment of its programs concerning the 2030 City Vision and SDGs, while strengthening evidence-based decision making, transparency, and accountability.
The project strategy comprises two main outcomes and three thematic outputs that trace a clear and specific path from phase one to phase two.
Outcome 1: San Nicolás positions as a change-maker on the implementation of climate change and public space transformation actions at the metropolitan level.
Output 1. Municipal strategy on Climate Action The purpose of this output is to strengthen municipal climate action planning through the development of an action plan that, in alignment with the strategic objectives of the city vision, proposes solutions, instruments, and concrete projects to address climate change at the local scale.
To this end, it is proposed to prepare a strategic diagnosis to identify, from a technical and participatory approach, different key elements and existing needs in the municipality to guide climate planning, including aspects of mitigation, adaptation, and local capacities.
Based on the strategic diagnosis, it is proposed to generate a series of technical recommendations for the strengthening of the institutional structure of the municipality for climate action, and to generate a detailed action plan with medium- and long-term objectives and actions. The inputs generated as part of the City Vision, as well as the guidelines defined by the Government of Mexico to contribute to the fulfillment of the different global agendas on climate action, including the Paris Agreement and the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction, will be used as a basis for the development of this action plan.
Finally, based on the defined action plan, it is proposed to develop a catalog of priority projects and proposals for action at the territorial scale, including proposals for green and blue infrastructure and nature-based solutions to address the needs identified from the diagnosis.
It is expected to develop specific indicators to monitor the implementation and impact of the output. This is relevant and will be considered as an input to output 3.
For this output, it is considered to collaborate with the Urban Lab.
Output 2. Municipal strategy for public space For Recreational Park Floridos Bosques and other public spaces The second output proposes to develop a strategy for intervention and design of public spaces on a neighbourhood scale, based on participatory processes with neighbours, workers, visitors, and passersby, using an inclusive perspective that considers gender, age, and interculturality. As part of this strategy, UN-Habitat will collaborate with the municipality on the development of the Recreational Park project in the Floridos Bosques del Nogalar (a strategic project promoted by the current local administration) and other public spaces. Likewise, it is proposed to accompany the municipality in the implementation of different actions derived from the Tactical Urbanism Plan developed as the first phase of the collaboration, including through the evaluation and follow-up of the interventions to encourage their permanent consolidation.
